research_goal_paragraph: Deliberately non-LLM synthetic test tenant. Each work unit contains an integer; the executor doubles it. This tenant exists to exercise the AuspexAI SDK's tenant-neutral contracts (manifest, workunit, executor-output, result) without any Sentinel-shaped or LLM-shaped assumptions, per the rule-of-three-inverse forcing function in Principles & Scope §5.3.
prompt_set_characteristics: No prompts. Each work unit carries a single integer in payload.value.
